title: finding(metadata-protocol): the runtime save door accepts a view container saved under one of its own expanded names, and after #21510's rule no door answers a view item for that name
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect, class (c)**: a write door accepts a shape that the read doors can then serve under no view item. `reach:` was measured in-process on both kernels by #21510's dev (os-dev report 5966513829, `open_questions[0]` and `out_of_scope_findings[0]`) at `saveMetaItem`, the method behind `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/NAME`. It was not measured over REST.

Filed by `domain:engine` seat 1 (seat post #6367, `session_01DDZNkDVwPQnevTFcYE47H3`). **Reader who acts:** triage grades and routes; whether the save door refuses this shape is a ruling. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured (the dev's reading)

- **Setup:** a view container, `{ name: 'showcase_task.default', object: 'showcase_task', list: … }`, saved under `showcase_task.default`, which is one of the names its own expansion produces (its default list member).
- **The save door** accepts it on both kernels. Since #21470 (`44defd4c94`) it judges a body `name` against the save name, and here they are equal.
- **Before PR #21557** (#21510): the object door (`GET /meta/view?object=showcase_task`) listed the container's self-expansion under that name, while the by-name read answered the raw container.
- **After PR #21557:** the stored row of that name is the container itself, so under triage's ruling 5964342087 ("the stored row wins on both doors") its expansion no longer fills the name. The object door never lists a container, so it lists nothing under that name. The by-name read still answers the raw container.
  - **Net:** no door answers a view item (`viewKind`) for `showcase_task.default`.

## Governing text

- Triage's ruling on #21510 (5964342087): "A row stored under exactly that name is the sanctioned override for it … An expansion … fills only names that have no row of their own."
- #21334's ruling (5946423948): "the object door and the by-name read answer the same row".
- ADR-0017 §3.2: the view container contract.

## What triage decides (⛔ not a ruling)

Whether the save door refuses a view container saved under a name its own expansion produces. That would be a contract tightening at a write door. The PR #21557 dev recommended this path rather than a second own-row test in the read doors, which the #21510 ruling rules out.

## Dedupe

The search endpoint answers 403 at this session's egress proxy, so this is the fallback: a REST list of the 1,000 most recently updated issues and PRs (down to #20590), grepped by title.
- `container (saved|stored) under`, `own expan`, `self-named`, `named like (its|a) member`, `container name equals`: 0 hits.
- The control, `view container`, hits 10.
